# WBench (vendored subset)

Three metric modules from [WBench](https://github.com/meituan-longcat/WBench) (MIT licence, see `LICENSE`):
`src/metrics/physical/visual_plausibility.py`, `src/metrics/physical/causal_plausibility.py` and
`src/metrics/interaction/vlm_interaction.py`. HandWorldBench calls them for Visual Plausibility,
Causal Plausibility and the action/event judges. The upstream README (paper, leaderboard, model zoo) is at the
link above; it is not copied here.
